subject: A single red pear, seen close enough to reveal its curved shoulder and stem
prompt:
USER SUBJECT: A single red pear, seen close enough to reveal its curved shoulder and stem
Preserve the user's requested identities, counts, setting, and layout. Add no default motifs.
VISUAL MEDIUM: oil_painting
REPRESENTATION: stylized
APPLY THESE AUTHORED VISUAL RULES:
- [selected-form-fills-the-view] Select one user-named form or feature and bring it close to the picture plane; crop only where the remaining silhouette and internal cues still identify the requested subject.
- [simplify-to-structural-color-shapes] Reduce secondary detail into a small number of broad color shapes; use smooth, controlled transitions along the form where they clarify curvature, and retain stronger local contrast only at the structural center or overlap.
- [form-following-negative-space] Shape the surrounding quiet areas around the selected form's curves, openings, and overlaps; keep the background simple but related in color and edge behavior to the subject.
- [close-form-identity-and-simplification] Let the selected contour, simplified color shapes, and surrounding negative space all describe the same requested form; retain at least one clear identity cue as the image approaches abstraction.
REQUIREMENT: Preserve the selected user subject and any requested view or aspect ratio.
REQUIREMENT: Enlarge one selected form only when close-observation context is declared.
REQUIREMENT: Simplify color and detail while keeping the subject identifiable.
REQUIREMENT: Make surrounding negative space follow the form's structure.

scope.description: An opt-in close-observation direction for one user-selected form. It enlarges a distinctive contour or internal structure toward the frame, simplifies color and surrounding detail, and lets the subject approach abstraction without losing its identity.
limitations: The user chooses the subject and which part to examine; do not default to flowers, bones, shells, or desert motifs.
Preserve enough identifying structure for the requested object, plant, rock, architecture, or portrait to remain legible.
Close cropping is an opt-in framing choice; do not force it onto a requested wide scene or complete-object view.

rules.applies_when: The caller requests close observation or an enlarged detail.
rules.instruction: Select one user-named form or feature and bring it close to the picture plane; crop only where the remaining silhouette and internal cues still identify the requested subject.
rules.observable: The chosen form occupies most of the frame and reads through a distinctive contour or structure rather than through surrounding context.
rules.reject_when: The crop hides essential requested information, invents an unrequested feature, or turns the subject into an anonymous texture.
rules.avoid: unsolicited macro crops, anonymous organic blobs, and hidden subject identity

rules.instruction: Reduce secondary detail into a small number of broad color shapes; use smooth, controlled transitions along the form where they clarify curvature, and retain stronger local contrast only at the structural center or overlap.
rules.observable: Large forms remain calm and legible, and color transitions explain the subject's volume instead of tinting the entire image.
rules.reject_when: A global pastel filter replaces observed color, gradients erase the form's structure, or decorative detail competes with the selected subject.
rules.avoid: all-over color filters, airbrush haze, and decorative detail accumulation

rules.applies_when: The selected form has a distinctive outer contour or opening.
rules.instruction: Shape the surrounding quiet areas around the selected form's curves, openings, and overlaps; keep the background simple but related in color and edge behavior to the subject.
rules.observable: The negative space helps reveal the form's proportions and direction, while the outer edge remains distinct from the background.
rules.reject_when: Background becomes a generic gradient, the subject is outlined uniformly, or its silhouette dissolves into adjacent colors.
rules.avoid: uniform dark outlines, detached gradient backdrops, and loss of silhouette

joint_checks.instruction: Let the selected contour, simplified color shapes, and surrounding negative space all describe the same requested form; retain at least one clear identity cue as the image approaches abstraction.
joint_checks.observable: The subject feels enlarged and distilled, yet its identifying structure remains visible and the empty areas actively shape the composition.

review.note: Successful compilation is not image-quality validation or a maturity upgrade.
